info.name: Nadara API v1
info.description:
Nadara clinic platform API.

Sign-in is split by portal: each front end has a door of its own, and the token it
hands back is stamped with that portal. A token minted at one door does not open
another, so "Login as PATIENT" then calling an admin route is a 403, not a 200.

Portals:
- Patient      POST /auth/login          (also /auth/register)
- Clinic       POST /clinic/auth/login   (doctor and secretary share it)
- Back office  POST /admin/auth/login

Shared, whichever door opened the session: /auth/me, /auth/logout,
/auth/logout-all and /auth/reset-password. Each portal has its own
forgot-password, and the reset link follows the account owner, not the endpoint.

Setup:
1. Run `php artisan serve` in the Backend folder.
2. Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` once to get the demo accounts.
3. Send the Login request for the portal you want. The token is saved into
   the {{token}} variable automatically, replacing whatever was there.

Demo accounts (password: `password`):
- admin@nadara.test      back office
- doctor@nadara.test     clinic
- secretary@nadara.test  clinic
- patient@nadara.test    patient

The Arabic demo set from DemoSeeder uses the password `nadara2026`:
- layla@nadara.test      clinic (doctor)
- sana@nadara.test       clinic (secretary)
- sara.demo@nadara.test  patient (and five more *.demo@nadara.test)

Folder 6 checks the split itself: the same correct password is rejected at the
wrong door, and it reads exactly like a wrong password so probing reveals nothing.

item.name: Book a time in the past (expect 422)

request.description: period: today | tomorrow | week (Saturday to Friday) | month. Days follow the clinic timezone, and results come oldest first. Cannot be combined with from/to.
from and to are Y-m-d dates in the clinic timezone, both inclusive. Either one may be sent alone.
Admin only: log in as an admin first. Any other role gets 422. Combines with period, from/to and status.
